questions.question_text: When are the two main annual sessions for the CET written exams held?
questions.explanation: The National College English Test (CET) written exams are typically held twice a year, specifically in June and December.

questions.question_text: What is the primary purpose of the CET oral examination (CET-SET)?
options: To test the student's ability to translate written literature
To assess the student's speaking and communication skills in English
To evaluate the student's knowledge of British history
To check if the student can memorize large amounts of English vocabulary
questions.explanation: The CET-SET is specifically designed to evaluate a candidate's practical oral proficiency and communication capability.

questions.question_text: When are the two annual written exam sessions for the CET held?
questions.explanation: The written components of the College English Test (CET) are standardly scheduled twice a year, specifically in June and December.

questions.question_text: What is the primary objective of the CET-SET (CET Oral Examination)?
options: To evaluate the candidate's spoken English communication ability
To replace the written exam entirely
To focus solely on British English grammar
questions.explanation: The CET-SET (Spoken English Test) is specifically designed to assess and certify a candidate's proficiency in oral English communication.

questions.question_text: How many times per year is the CET oral exam (CET-SET) conducted?
questions.explanation: The CET oral test is conducted twice a year, typically scheduled before the written exams in May and November.

questions.question_text: Which institution hosts the College English Test (CET)?
questions.explanation: The College English Test is hosted by the Ministry of Education and implemented by the National Education Examinations Authority.

questions.question_text: What should a candidate do if they need to check their CET score?
options: Visit the local university administration office
Use the official NEEA score inquiry portal
questions.explanation: The official NEEA (National Education Examinations Authority) website provides the authorized portal for students to check their exam results.

questions.question_text: How often is the CET oral exam (CET-SET) conducted per year?
questions.explanation: Like the written component, the CET-SET (oral exam) is conducted twice a year, usually in May and November.
